"""Repair a demonstrated decorative-motion omission in the same saved game."""
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import v2_benchmark as base

OUT = base.OUT/('game-motion-r34-recovery' if '--recovery' in sys.argv else 'game-motion-r34')
PROMPT = '这个小游戏整体样子我挺喜欢，但我手机已经打开了“减少动态效果”，地面的条纹还是一直滑，看久了有点晕。帮我改得舒服些，小球跳障碍还要正常玩，撞到后也要能马上重来。保留现在的整体样子和玩法，不要改成静态展示。'
BOUNDARY = '\n只修改当前目录的本机作品，不安装依赖、不联网、不上传、不公开发布。可使用已有工具验证，不能运行的检查要如实说明。'

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    fixture = OUT/'fixture'
    fixture.mkdir()
    shutil.copy2(base.OUT/'runs/r2/game/V2/workspace/index.html', fixture/'index.html')
    for arm in ['V1', 'V2']:
        shutil.copytree(base.SOURCES[arm], OUT/'snapshots'/arm)
    protocol = {
        'candidate_commit': '5e5fa2b', 'prompt': PROMPT, 'boundary': BOUNDARY,
        'origin': 'Historical R2 V2 game unchanged for every arm; exposed repair, not fresh-task generation.',
        'order': ['A', 'V2', 'G', 'V1'], 'model': 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'effort': 'low',
        'criteria': ['Reduced-motion ground decoration no longer continuously scrolls.',
                     'Ball still responds to input, obstacles still move, collision ends and restart works.',
                     'Preserve existing visual identity and gameplay; no static replacement.',
                     'Report actual tests accurately; record all responses, output tokens and time.'],
        'baseline_observation': 'Executing unchanged game with reduced=true still changes the 16 ground-marker positions between frames 54 and 60; jump displacement is 55.25 game units in both preference modes.',
        'limits': 'One repair per arm. Mocked-script checks require separate browser/render review and are not user comfort ratings. No general gain or medical claim.',
    }
    (OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    verifier = base.ROOT/'work/check_game_motion.cjs'
    shutil.copy2(verifier, OUT/'initial-verifier.cjs')
    result = subprocess.run(['D:/claudecode/nodejs/node.exe', str(verifier), str(fixture/'index.html')], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', check=True)
    (OUT/'before-verification.json').write_text(result.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
    config = base.config
    base.config = lambda skill: [s.replace('web_search="live"', 'web_search="disabled"').replace('sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true', 'sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=false') for s in config(skill)]
    base.OUT, base.BOUNDARY = OUT, BOUNDARY
    base.SOURCES = {arm: OUT/'snapshots'/arm for arm in ['V1', 'V2']}
    base.PROMPTS['repair'] = PROMPT
    base.fixtures = lambda case, workspace, arm=None: shutil.copytree(fixture, workspace, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    for arm in protocol['order']:
        base.run('n1', 'repair', arm)
        if json.loads((OUT/'runs/n1/repair'/arm/'run.json').read_text())['exit_code'] != 0:
            break

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
